content.title: Experience Major Championship Golf at Aronimink Golf Club
content.text: Major Championship golf returns to the Philadelphia region for the 108th playing of the PGA Championship in May 2026. Join us at Aronimink Golf Club to witness the strongest field in golf compete. Championship+ and Club PGA tickets are available for purchase.Please note that Championship+ Grounds Tickets for Thursday, Friday, Saturday, and Sunday have sold out. For individuals hoping to attend the sold-out Championship rounds, verified resale tickets are now available through SeatGeek, the Official Resale Ticket Provider for the PGA of America.Read more about our junior and military ticket policy here. Pricing may vary based on demand and other market conditions. SeatGeek is the Official Ticketing Provider for the PGA of America. Championship+ Grounds Tickets include: Access to the grounds of Aronimink Golf Club for the chosen day(s).Inclusive food & non-alcoholic beverage offerings at all concession venues throughout the grounds. Private hospitality areas are not included.The opportunity to receive one (1) entrée item, one (1) snack item, and one (1) non-alcoholic beverage each time a Championship+ Ticket holder visits a concession venue - and return as many times as they like!A wide selection of alcoholic beverages for purchase.Access to public grandstand seating, The PGA Shops presented by Chase Sapphire, and other spectator amenities. Daily Club PGA Hospitality Tickets The perfect venue for clients, family, or friends. These tickets are the only individual hospitality tickets available for purchase Thursday through Sunday. Club PGA is still available in limited quantities. Act now to secure your tickets.Enjoy a premium experience overlooking Aronimink's 8th & 10th Greens with chef-inspired menus and an open bar.Multiple televisions to keep up with the action on the course, an open-air deck with views of multiple holes, air/heat, executive restrooms, Wi-Fi, stylish décor, and first-class service.Preferred access to reserve hotels and home rentals.Max purchase # on SeatGeek: 10To purchase more than 10 Club PGA tickets, please reach out to 2026pga@pgahq.com Official PGA Championship Travel Packages Official Travel Packages Include:An Official Championship+ Ticket for single or multi-day access to Aronimink Golf Club.Hotel accommodations conveniently located, paired with roundtrip daily transportation to the tournament grounds.Exclusive access to On Location’s dedicated on-site event staff, providing personalized assistance throughout your experience.An Official PGA Championship Souvenir Gift to commemorate your experience.A seamless and elevated PGA Championship experience — from arrival to final round. Admissions Policies Junior General AdmissionAges 15 & under receive free grounds access when accompanied by a ticketed adult. Children under the age of 2 do not need a ticket for grounds access.A maximum of 2 free junior grounds tickets per adult can be collected on-site.All individuals, regardless of age, must have a hospitality ticket to enter any hospitality venue/area; complimentary junior grounds tickets do not include hospitality accessPGA of America reserves the right to request proof of age (e.g., valid student ID) at the point of Junior Ticket redemption and to deny entry to the PGA Championship to anyone who violates or attempts to violate the Junior Admission Policy.Military General AdmissionActive Duty, Retirees, Veterans, Reserve, and National Guard can receive free grounds access along with one (1) accompanying guest for each day of the Championship Qualifying individuals can now register for a chance to receive tickets through GOVXSee requirements below to receive tickets:Step 1: Register for PGA Championship tickets through GOVX (registration does not guarantee tickets)Step 2: Following verification, select the day of the Championship you would like to attend. A unique access code for the chosen day will be provided. Select “use your code” which will direct you to SeatGeek to reserve your attendance. Please do this for each day you plan to attend.Please note: the access code must be used on SeatGeek.com or the SeatGeek mobile app to claim tickets. SeatGeek is the Official Ticketing Provider of the PGA of AmericaSubject to availability. Ticket inventory is limited, and is first come, first served.Please note: Thursday - Sunday military tickets have sold out and are no longer available. Monday - Wednesday tickets remain, subject to availability.
